name: How often should I schedule regular home maintenance for an elderly family member?

mainEntity.name: How often should I schedule regular home maintenance for an elderly family member?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of home maintenance depends on various factors, including the age and mobility of the senior, the condition of the home, and the local climate. Generally, scheduling routine check-ups at least quarterly or semi-annually is a good practice. This allows for proactive identification and resolution of minor issues before they become major problems. Seasonal maintenance, such as gutter cleaning in the fall or AC checks in the spring, should also be factored in. For seniors with increased mobility challenges, more frequent assessments might be beneficial to ensure ongoing safety and accessibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule regular senior home maintenance quarterly or semi-annually, with seasonal tasks included. More frequent checks may be needed for those with mobility challenges.
